propositions: Write operation parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across Python lib, CLI, and MCP adapters with no mechanical guard against divergence; Parameter gaps on MCP adapter (reason, caused_by, force on transition/claim) are caught only by chance or LLM review, not by automated behavioral testing

A conformance oracle suite executes a single shared contract table of (op, inputs, expected accept/reject) through all three adapters against fresh stores, mechanically detecting any behavioral divergence on parameter acceptance/rejection without LLM or change-detector
Runtime conditional rules (close_class required, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) must be asserted behaviorally across all three adapters to catch silent enforcement drift

MCP parameter exposure gaps are detected from inputSchema.properties and encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago; closing a gap flips xfail to xpass, forcing marker removal and providing forcing function for cleanup

The oracle reuses the existing three-adapter harness (Outcome, Adapter protocol, Library/Cli/MCP implementations) extended to thread write-op parameters (force, reason, close_class, caused_by, ref) through each transport without building fresh parallel drivers
